name: webserver-nginx
description: Nginx web server with port mapping (8080:80)
setupScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
systemctl enable nginx
systemctl start nginx
echo 'Nginx installed and started'
postInstallScript:
#!/bin/bash echo '

Thresh Web Server Test

Port mapping is working!

' > /var/www/html/index.html echo 'Custom index page created' curl -s http://localhost || echo 'Nginx test request sent'
